verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a clean API surface for reading FinancialAccount objects and the full Transaction ledger. Every fund movement creates a Transaction, and the docs explicitly support building activity feeds and reconciliation. Related objects such as ReceivedDebits and OutboundPayments, plus transaction webhooks, give an agent programmatic access without the Dashboard, and an official Stripe MCP server and LLM-friendly docs exist. However, pending or in-flight activity is only implied, statements and documents are not evidenced at all, and nothing shows the MCP server exposes Treasury data. Missing for 10: documented API access to pending/in-flight transaction states, statements or account documents via API, evidence the MCP server covers Treasury accounts and transactions, independent hands-on corroboration of agent read access.
